known_gaps: Park-area labels were verified for 27 vendor records from individual OSL app detail rows. 74 vendor.location fields remain TBD. A16 appears in two VIP detail rows and remains TBD because this dataset currently supports one location per vendor.
Walk times are estimates from prior-year Golden Gate Park maps, not measured. Verify against the official 2026 map.
Dish lists are complete only for the ~24 vendors press coverage named. The other 77 are name-and-tier only; fill from the app or the OSL site if dish-level matching matters.
Snack Series is 20+ vendors; only 4 are public so far.
Organizer Trav confirmed on the OSLLMSG board that set times will be in the JamBase dataset Andy Gadiel provides at the event. Reconcile at kickoff.
Sunday Panhandle shows Silvana Estrada and Infinity Song overlapping in the source. Verify onsite.

walk_times_minutes_estimated.note: Rough, gate-to-gate with festival crowds. Treat as floor, add 5 min during headliner moves.

demo_conflict.cost_sentence_template: Leave {stage} at {t}, walk {walk} min, wait {queue} min, and you hand back {overlap} minutes of {artist}.

limited_edition.implication: A limited-edition dish is not a 20-minute detour, it is a be-there-early-or-never decision. Cost model should treat these as expiring inventory, not queue time.

snack_series.implication: Published Snack Series items cost $16 or less. Do not infer a portion size or time saving where one is not listed.
